notes.title: The end is only the beginning for Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds
notes.content:
Dear Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Fans,

We want to share with you some important news regarding Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds. Back in June 2022 we (Rocket Panda Games) announced that we had acquired the Phantom Breaker IP from MAGES. and became the new stewards for the direction of the franchise with much excitement and we would like to share with you about what the future holds for the Phantom Breaker universe.

One of our goals with every one of our games is to ensure the best possible gaming experience for fans as well as users new to the world of Phantom Breaker.

The staff at Rocket Panda Games have been fans of Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds since its original release over 10 years ago on Xbox 360. In that time, technology has advanced and the bar has only gotten higher for games. The engine on which the original games were built is simply not conducive to being updated or added to, which makes it impossible for us to make any meaningful updates or add new content.

If you’re a big PBBG fan, the fight doesn’t end here!
On September 23rd, 2023 we announced Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate for Steam (PC), the Epic Game Store as well as PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox S | X and Nintendo Switch for release in 2024.

This new game will be a remaster of the exceptional beat ‘em up that you’ve come to love but we’re confident that the new version will captivate you with its enhanced online features, modern design, and re-tuned gameplay.

The new Battle Grounds game is being developed in-house by Rocket Panda Games with some of the same developers responsible for the original Battle Grounds as well as Phantom Breaker: Omnia.  Their love of the franchise will ensure that the gameplay will be rock-solid while adding modern features and a scalable backend.

What’s going to happen to Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds and Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Overdrive?
The current versions of Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds and Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Overdrive developed and published by MAGES. will be removed from all digital storefronts along with related DLC content on March 4th, 2024.

While both games and related DLC will no longer be available for new purchases from March 4th 2024, current owners will retain access to the game in their game library and can continue enjoying it without interruption.

Thank you for being a part of this extraordinary adventure, and we look forward to showing you more of Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate in the near future.

– The Rocket Panda Games Team

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
For any specific questions regarding the transition or the new game, please visit the official Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate website. For questions regarding Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds, contact our support here.

How is Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate going to differ from vanilla Battle Grounds and Overdrive?
Ultimate is being built from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5 and contains quite a number of new features and improvements on top of the classic Battle Grounds experience. Visit the official website for more information at pbbgu.com. 

Can I still play the original Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds (PBBG) and Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Overdrive (PBBGOD) after they’re removed?
Yes, you will always be able to play the games’ offline modes as long as it remains in your library. All editions of PBBG and PBBGOD use their native platform’s online services. As long as those services are available, players should be able to matchmake and play online sessions.

*Online functionality for the Vita version of PBBG is no longer available.

Is there a way to migrate my progress to the new game?
Because the game will be running on a completely new engine made by a different developer, your progress from PBBG and PBBGOD will not be able to be transferred to Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate.

Can I transfer my DLC purchases from the old game to Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate?
Previous DLC like the Kurisu Makise, Frau, Kemomimi Costume DLC, and FM sound generator BGM will be included in the base game of Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate. Any future DLC will have to be purchased for Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate as it is a brand new game in Unreal Engine 5.

notes.title: Announcing, OGRE TALE!
notes.content:
It's the fracturedest of fairytales!

OGRE TALE is a 2D sprite-based beat-em-up available August 20th, 2020 for PC/Steam, from the same team that brought you Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds. Featuring 3 distinct playable characters with meticulous customization options, a tongue-in-cheek story filled with fourth wall breaks, snark, and meta-humor, and cooperative multiplayer functionality for up to 3 players at a time (either online or off!), OGRE TALE is the ultimate far-east fairytale farce!

[previewyoutube=ygFTyhcpqqw;full][/previewyoutube]

Learn more about the game, wishlist it, check out screenshots, interact with the community, or just plain ogle it to your heart's content at its Steam page hereabouts: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1124050/Ogre_Tale/

Or if you're looking to hone your Japanese ability a little, check out its Japanese homepage here: http://5pb.jp/games/ogretale/

The Onigashima sisters thank you for your support over this week-long teaser campaign!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7670762/646ccf07eef89c210eb58802443a83cff2e2a0f2.gif

THE STORY SO FAR

Hundreds of years ago, there dwelled ogres alongside humankind. These ogres were known to cause no end of problems for the humans they came upon, leading them to be feared and hated, regarded as monsters and demons.
 
One day, a trio of soon-to-be folk heroes named Momotaro, Kintaro, and Issuntaro decided enough was enough, and set foot upon the land from whence the ogres came: Onigashima. Their goal was to confront the ogres on their own turf and take them down once and for all... and so they did.
 
After a long struggle, Momotaro and his crew successfully defeated the leader of the ogres: the beautiful yet dreaded Iroha. And with Iroha's defeat, the ogres themselves fell to ruin, and peace once again reigned for humanity. Momotaro, Kintaro, and Issuntaro were heralded as heroes, and they all lived happily ever after...
 
Or did they?!

Tokyo, present day.

Iroha, having used an ancient technique for reincarnation upon herself just moments before her demise, has lived many lives in many forms. Finally, after nearly giving up hope, she discovers the last surviving ogres: a trio of sisters bearing the name of their ancient homeland, Onigashima. She (or, now, he, as a male cat) raises them as her/his own, strictly teaching them the ways of the sword so that one day, s/he may lead them into battle against Momotaro and reclaim the ogres' rightful place in society.

And fortunately for them, Momotaro is indeed still out there! Specifically, a guy named Momotaro -- who happens to be a 37th generation descendant of the original -- just so happens to have been toiling day in and day out as a host in the red light district, and has finally reached his breaking point. He has PLANS now, and suffice it to say, they're not exactly folk-heroic!

So, hey, this was supposed to just be a petty revenge story, but with Momotaro suddenly turning evil due to systemic depression, maybe the ogres can actually be the good guys this time around! Lucky... them, I guess?

What even IS this story, anyway?!

notes.title: Online Co-Op Update
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,
Apologies for the very overdue announcement.

We ran into some developmental roadblocks with the Online Multiplayer Integration for Phantom Breaker Battle Grounds on PC.

The good news is that we’ve made significant progress and will be starting alpha testing next month.

We’re hoping to have a full, public release available in the not too distant future.

Here’s a screenshot of the lobby screen working as intended.
https://d289qh4hsbjjw7.cloudfront.net/rpgmaker-20130522223546811/files/pbbglobby.png

Here’s a quick overview of the two different online modes:

4P Co-op
Play arcade mode together with up to 3 other people.

Battleground
Free for all action with 2-4 players

We realize this is much longer than our original target date of August and for this we apologize. We’re working on something cool to make up for the delay.

Thanks very much for your patience and for bearing with us.
We’ll keep you updated as we make further progress on this.

Looking forward to seeing you in online multiplayer soon!!

The Phantom Breaker Team

notes.title: Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Development Update 07/02/2015
notes.content:
PBBG Development Update 07/02/2015

Greetings to the Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds community!

Patch update V1.05 is going live shortly and will include a fix for excessive speed on monitors with high refresh rates.  V1.05 also adds online leaderboards to the game for both Arcade and Co-op modes.

In addition to the patch, we also have more information about the the game's continuing development.  

Planned features like improved key configuration and online multiplayer have been delayed by extensive work on Phantom Breaker Battle Grounds: Overdrive, the PS4 port of PBBG, which diverted the development team from work on the PC version for some time.

We now expect key configuration updates by the end of this month, and online multiplayer later this year.  Although these updates have been delayed, development has resumed and we are continuing development on these features as planned.  

The upside of this is that with the PS4 version out soon, Mages is still committed to support all versions of PBBG for a long time. 
  
Thank you for your continuing support!

Best wishes, the Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds team.

notes.title: V1.04 Update: Achievements & fixes / 実績追加と修正
notes.content:
v1.04 detail
◆[ADD] Achievements are now active. Any achievements you should already have received will be unlocked on first startup.
◆[FIX] Save problem have been resolved. The save size is back to 7kb and the problem on first save creation should be solved for all configuration.
◆[FIX]  Multiplay using keyboard and one controller is now available: whichever you use first when starting the game will be player 1, and you can use the other for player 2.
◆[FIX] Keyboard keys "T" and "I" should now work normally

v1.04　変更詳細
◆[追加] 実績が取得可能になりました。すでに取得条件を満たしている場合、一部実績については、ゲーム起動時に取得されます。
◆[修正] セーブの問題が修正されました。セーブファイルのサイズが元の7KBに戻され、新規セーブ中に発生する問題も改善されました。
◆[改善] キーボードとコントローラを使ったマルチプレイ に対応しました。起動時に最初に使用したデバイスがプレイヤー1に割り当てられます。
◆[修正] キー"T"と"I"が使用できない問題を修正しました。
◆[新規] 日本語の問題報告フォーラムの対応を開始しました。何か問題が御座いましたら是非ご報告ください。

notes.title: March Update! Kurisu Pack Launch and Online Multiplayer Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone!  Today is March 13th, the launch date for both the initial patch update and the Kurisu Makise + Level 99 DLC.

The initial patch is performance-oriented and aims to fix the issues causing unacceptably low framerates for some users.  Another major fix is intended to address situations where the progress triggers in some stages would fail, preventing players from completing the stage. Several other minor issues were corrected as well.

The major issue that hasn't been corrected is the crash during the opening video, which we haven't found a solution for yet.  We didn't want to hold up the release of the other fixes any longer, though.  We will continue looking for a fix to this issue and include it in a later update when a fix is found.
  
For a detailed list of the patch notes, please check out the patch notes thread:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/329490/discussions/0/610575007204561164

The highly-requested Kurisu Makise character pack is also available today, which introduces Kurisu Makise as a playable character and raises the level cap to level 99.  Both the base game and the DLC will have a discount this week, so if you were waiting for this update, please take a look!  I hope that you will all enjoy blasting through the stages with some future gadgets.

I also have some important updates about the future updates timetable for Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds.

As you may have guessed from the icons on the PBBG Steam page, achievements are currently being implemented.  We're also working on arcade leaderboards.  These updates will most likely be released at the end of this month.  We're going to push back the updated key configuration options until April to allow for a little more testing time, but they are still on track for release.
  
I am also excited to confirm that Mages will implement online multiplayer.  This is a complex feature that will require lots of development to get correct.  Our plan is to complete this feature this summer, but there is a possibility of a public beta sooner than that if development results in a stable build faster than expected.  We plan to make online multiplayer a free content update so that everyone in the community can enjoy this feature to it's fullest.

We hope that you will look forward to the continued development of PBBG!
Best wishes,

The Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds team.

notes.title: V1.03 Patch : Performance update, glitches and DLC
notes.content:
V1.03 Patch Details

◆General performance updates to improve framerates for users experiencing excessive slowdown.
◆Corrected a situation where progress triggers in some stages would fail, preventing players from completing the stage.
◆The game should now properly remember the display settings (full screen) when you quit.
◆The autosave notification at the start of the game has been removed.
◆The continue screen on the Battlegrounds mode should now work properly.
◆Some corrections were made to the text of the Italian translation.
◆Some changes to accommodate the Kurisu pack DLC update.
